findings.title: Missing `key` on GrafanaRuleListItem in the filtered rules list
findings.body: The previous `GrafanaRuleLoader` element had `key={key}`. The new `<GrafanaRuleListItem ... />` returned from `rules.map` has no key. The other `datasource` and `default` branches still pass `key`. React will warn about missing keys. Reconciliation falls back to index, so as filtered results stream in or get reordered, rows can reuse the wrong component state. That includes each row's delete modal, silence drawer and clone-redirect state, because `RuleActionsButtons` holds `useState`. Pass `key={key}` as before.

findings.title: Delete and Pause menu items can never render in the list view (no rulerRule)
findings.body: The list view now passes only `promRule`, and `rulerRule` is undefined. `canDelete`/`canPause` are computed from the prom-rule abilities, but the items are still gated on a ruler rule. Delete is wrapped in `canDelete && rulerRule`, and Pause requires `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)`. So in the Grafana alert list, Delete and Pause are silently dropped even for users with permission. `showDivider` still counts `canPause`, so a stray divider can appear. The new `GrafanaGroupLoader` test also encodes this: delete permission is granted, yet it asserts exactly 4 menu items with no Delete. The Delete handler and `MenuItemPauseRule` need to work from the prom rule or a rule identifier, not `RulerRuleDTO`.

findings.title: Silence menu item is shown but the drawer never opens in the list view
findings.body: `AlertRuleMenu` shows 'Silence notifications' from the prom-rule ability and calls `handleSilence`, which sets `showSilenceDrawer` to true. The drawer is only rendered when `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule) && showSilenceDrawer`. In the list view `rule` (the ruler rule) is undefined, so the condition is always false. Clicking Silence does nothing, which is a dead menu entry. The drawer needs to be driven by the prom rule, or the item hidden when no ruler rule is available.

findings.title: Export/Pause/Restore/DeletePermanently disabled for Grafana recording rules in the new prom hook
findings.body: The ruler-based hook gates ModifyExport, Pause, Restore and DeletePermanently on `isGrafanaManagedAlertRule`, which is true for both alerting and recording Grafana rules. The new `useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities` gates them on `isAlertingRule` (`prometheusRuleType.grafana.alertingRule`). The in-code comment says 'All GrafanaPromRuleDTO rules are Grafana-managed by definition', which contradicts this. Result: recording rules lose Export and Pause in the list view, which they previously had. Only Silence should be restricted to alerting rules. The new tests use only alerting rules, so this is not covered.

findings.title: Federated rule group check dropped for the deprecated useAllAlertRuleAbilities path
findings.body: `useAllAlertRuleAbilities` used to compute `isFederated = isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group)`, which made federated (Mimir `source_tenants`) groups immutable. It now delegates to `useAllRulerRuleAbilities`, which hardcodes `isFederated = false` with a TODO. Every existing caller (e.g. `RulesTable`, `RuleDetails`) therefore now offers Edit, Delete and Pause on federated rule groups. This is a silent behaviour regression unrelated to the stated goal of removing the ruler from the list view. Pass the federated flag through, or keep the old check in the deprecated wrapper.

findings.title: returnTo parameter dropped from rule view link
findings.body: The removed `GrafanaRuleLoader`/`GrafanaRuleListItem` built the href with `createRelativeUrl(..., { returnTo: createReturnTo() })`. The new component links to `/alerting/grafana/${uid}/view` with no `returnTo`. The rule view page can therefore no longer send the user back to the filtered list or position they came from. Nothing in the PR says this was intended, and the updated tests only check `stringContaining('/alerting/grafana/<uid>/view')`, so they would not catch it.

findings.title: Stale comment and variable name referring to ruler preload
findings.body: The ruler prefetch dispatch was removed, but the comment ('This is not mandatory to preload ruler rules...') and the variable `cacheAndRulerPreload` still describe ruler preloading. This misleads readers into thinking ruler data is still loaded here. Rename and update the comment.

findings.title: GrafanaGroupLoader docs still say it loads from the Ruler endpoint
findings.body: The component doc ('Loads an evaluation group from Prometheus and Ruler endpoints') and the `expectedRulesCount` comment ('Ruler response might contain different number of rules') are now wrong. The ruler query was removed and the component only uses the Prometheus endpoint.

findings.title: Tests lose coverage of removed behaviours and lock in the missing Delete/Pause actions
findings.body: The tests for creating/deleting operation states and for `matchRules` were removed. The one remaining menu test grants delete and update permissions but asserts exactly four items (silence, copy link, duplicate, export), so it passes even though Delete and Pause are missing. There is no test that clicking Silence opens the drawer, or that Delete or Pause work from the list view. The RulesTable negative tests pass trivially because the default mocks return `[false, false]` for every ability.
